title: Automate changelog and onboard Orpheus-14b-v1.0 (metadata + perf profiles)
author: Maya Chen
description: Onboard new model Orpheus-14b v1.0 into the model registry and wire up automated changelog/release note generation. Motivation: Orpheus is a high-quality open 14B model with good latency characteristics on our 80GB GPU profiles; serving teams requested a canonical metadata + perf profile entry and automated changelog so product, docs, and infra teams can consume release notes without manual edits. Changes include: (1) model metadata (manifest, aliases, tags), (2) performance profiles (seq distributions, batch/latency numbers for verified GPU targets), (3) integration into the changelog generator so onboarding events produce a draft release note in markdown, and (4) small docs updates and examples (quickstart manifest). Checklist: - [x] Add model manifest (name, version, flavors, canonical config) - [x] Add perf profile JSON for 80GB/40GB/32GB targets with measured throughput/latency - [x] Hook onboarding step to changelog automation (auto-draft) - [x] Add CI job to validate perf profile schema - [x] Add docs snippet and quickstart example - [x] Run full performance harness and attach summary Results and rollout plan: Verified perf profiles against internal benchmark-lab (results attached in perf-summaries/). We stage the model to canary in dedicated for one week before full public listing. See linked linear tickets for rollout acceptance criteria. Notes: the changelog automation will place a draft markdown in /changelogs/drafts/orpheus-14b-v1.0.md for maintainers to edit before release. If changelog auto-generation flags unknown fields, the job will create an issue in the model-registry board.

Sofia Morales: Changelog auto-draft looks good; suggest including a short 'what changed for users' blurb - added a template snippet to the generator.

merge_outcome: Merged via squash by Maya Chen after approvals
release_notes:
- Onboarded Orpheus-14b v1.0 to the model registry with metadata and aliases.
- Added verified performance profiles for 80GB/40GB/32GB targets (throughput and p95/p99 latency measurements).
- Integrated onboarding workflow with automated changelog generator which drafts release notes under /changelogs/drafts.
- Added CI validation for perf profile schema to prevent regressions.
notes: Perf profiles validated on benchmark-lab machines (internal). Team to monitor first week of canary for unexpected regressions; rollback plan is to mark the model as private and roll traffic to aurora-13b fallbacks if unit cost or latency regressions occur.
